Class ParametricAnalysisDefinition

java.lang.Object
common.definitions.parametric.ParametricAnalysisDefinition
All Implemented Interfaces:
ParametricAnalysis
Direct Known Subclasses:
ArrivalRateParametricAnalysis, NumberOfCustomerParametricAnalysis, NumberOfServersParametricAnalysis, PopulationMixParametricAnalysis, RoutingProbabilitiesParametricAnalysis, SeedParametricAnalysis, ServiceTimesParametricAnalysis, TotalStationCapacityParametricAnalysis
public abstract class ParametricAnalysisDefinition extends Object implements ParametricAnalysis

Title: ParametricAnalysisDefinition

Description: this class represents a description of the parametric analysis to be performed. It includes the initial and final value, and the number of steps. Each type of parametric analysis is described by a subclass of this class.

Author:
Francesco D'Aquino Date: 14-dic-2005 Time: 10.57.24

    • checkCorrectness

      public abstract int checkCorrectness(boolean autocorrect)
      Checks if the PA model is still coherent with simulation model definition. If the autocorrect variable is set to true, if the PA model is no more valid but it can be corrected it will be changed.
      Parameters:
      autocorrect - if true the PA model will be autocorrected
      Returns:
      0 - If the PA model is still valid
      1 - If the PA model is no more valid, but it will be corrected
      2 - If the PA model can be no more used
